spiritual_reading:
# Spiritual Translation of the Chapter of the Three Vessels

---

** ¶1:**

Tell us, our master, and instruct us concerning these three recept acles of evil — of fals ified truth, of pure falsity, and of infernal love — that were separated out from the interior mind and expelled from above, and how they were extracted and divided away from all the ruling affections that are arranged in the inter iors of the mind . For it is necessary for us to understand the manner in which these three contain ments of evil were expelled , while the ruling affections were still flourishing in their life .

**¶2:**

When these recept acles of evil were separated out, they were expelled through a great spiritual devast ation; yet those [ operations of Divine Providence] drew these contain ments of evil forth from the ruling affections.

**¶3:** They are like the form of a mind that has fallen into a deep corruption of the will. Other fals ities and disorders d well within it , and even b itt erness and spiritual po isons r eside in its interior fac ulties. This mind is restored to whol eness by Divine Wisdom, who administ ers one truth to be received in wardly that causes the corruption of the will to break forth into the conscious understanding above , and administ ers another truth that causes the disorder to be expelled down ward into the natural mind, and administ ers yet another truth that heals the wounds of fals ity g ently and in the still ness of interior peace .

**¶4:**

Through the skill of Divine Wisdom, with effective tru ths received inwardly that consume all spiritual disorders and dissolve all enchantments of persu asive falsity, the operations of Providence work their healing through the sphere of influence of divine truth. Other wounds of falsity that were hidden — these at last are torn out from the inter iors and made manifest both in the understanding and in the natural mind, through the sphere of life - giving truths that were applied upon them.

**¶5:**

This is also what these three recept acles — of fals ified truth, of pure falsity, and of infernal love — are like , which lie hidden within the life of all the ruling affections of the interior mind; while Divine Providence operating through wisdom is like the wise he aler. These three healing truths are the three external forms of truth that Divine Providence assumes upon itself : the truth of rational understanding, the truth of purification , and the truth of the Lord 's zeal ous love. Through these, Providence has set in order the things of the lower natural mind. For by those three forms of truth, Providence was made manifest to the ruling affections of the interior mind — and those aff ections responded with obst inacy, with trem bling and terror , with confusion of every kind. From those ruling affections, Providence expelled the three receptacles: those of fals ified truth, of pure falsity, and of infernal love.

** ¶6:** The condition of these receptacles of evil is like a new spiritual life forming in the interior of the old nature, wrapped within seven successive degrees of the existing constitution . The first is the in most good of the will , the second is the structural truth that supports it , the third is the conn ective power that bin ds interior things to exterior, the fourth is the substance of natural good , the fifth is the channels through which life flows, the sixth is the living truth that circ ulates through every part , and the seventh is the ou termost natural form that encompasses all. There is yet another covering beyond these within the encomp assing old nature. And the encomp assing old nature is constit uted in the same way as this new interior life. The inmost good and the structural truth, the connective faculty and natural good, the channels of life and circ ulating truth and ou termost form , together with the external tru ths the old nature w ears and the cov erings that wrap it — these total nine. Together with the nine of the new interior life, these and the others complete eighteen degrees of covering . And you shall find that the spiritual life of this new formation is entwined within every one of these degrees .

**¶7:**

And see: when the influence of the activity of evil , which produces the crisis of emergence into out ward life, reveals the new spiritual formation — immediately all these cov erings yield , and the new life emerges through an opening that becomes visible, while no destruction nor injury occurs to the new spiritual life itself . In the same way that this new interior life opens the encomp assing old nature, so it is also with these receptacles of fals ified truth, of pure falsity, and of infernal love. The operations that open the old nature to release the new life , causing the old nature to shake forth and reveal what is within — these are the three living forms of truth that Divine Providence assumed upon itself.

**¶8:** For by the aspect of the truth of pur ification, Providence drew forth from the ruling affections that which was hidden within them : the spiritual poison and the death of the will with which their interior channels and fac ulties were filled.

**¶ 9:** By the aspect of the truth of rational understanding, through which Providence was made manifest, it swept away and eff aced the entire destructive shadow of ignor ance and contamination of falsity, exp elling it down ward into the natural mind. Afterward , it swept this fals ity out entirely and confined it within the recept acle of pure darkness that surrounds the whole of the spiritual world — that is, the ou termost boundary where fals ity is held in contain ment.

**¶10:**

Also, by the form of living zeal ous love, through its splendor and power , Providence expelled the inf ernal self-love from all the ruling affections and cast it down into the natural mind. It swept it a second time from the natural mind and confined it in the receptacle that surrounds all states of existence , and this is called the wall of the great consuming fire — the outermost boundary where infernal love is held fast .

**¶11:**

Now, those three forms of truth, through which Providence established these three separ ations, were not removed all at once; but Providence set aside each one individually at the appointed stage of the process, desc ending degree by degree into the natural mind.

**¶12:** In this manner the whole of the spiritual world and its recept acles of evil were ordered .

**¶13:** The purpose of these ev ils, and the management of these receptacles that were swept out and expelled from the interior mind down to the natural level , have brought an advantage and benefit of twelve great work ings of Providence. Afterward, these ev ils were swept from the natural mind and pushed out ward to the utter most boundaries of spiritual existence, to the extrem ity .

**¶14:**

The first working is this: so that evil- doing does not multiply throughout the spiritual world — neither in the formations of life nor in the per ceptions of the mind . This evil had established itself in three forms .

**¶15:** The first is [ lost to damage ].

**¶16:** The second is the persu asion of falsity. For if it had been so — if the receptacle of falsified truth had not been swept down from the interior mind, but rather the perv erted truths existing until now among the ruling affections above had remained — then the torr ents of falsity that would flow down, and the subtle infl uxes that would desc end, would have caused lust to spr out contin ually in the perceptions and in the works of life as well as in the entire will.

**¶17:**

Not only this, but if the receptacle of pure falsity had not been swept out and cast down to the natural mind, nor swept from the natural mind and expelled outside the region of all spiritual states into the pit of con finement — then the drops of ignor ance that would drip down from it, and the torrents of darkness that would continue to flow from the inter iors down into the natural mind and take hold of every perception and every act of the will, would have multiplied beyond measure.

**¶18:**

Furthermore, if inf ernal self -love had remained in the ruling aff ections of the interior states of the mind until this day, and had not been swept out and cast down to the natural level , and swept from the natural level and shut up inside the receptacle of consuming fire that surrounds all states of existence — then this inf ernal love , flowing as a torrent from above to below —

**¶19:** — the dark fire of self -love would have multiplied in every perception and in every work and in the entire will.

**¶21 :** The second working: All the interior states of mind were cle ansed of the sediment and contam ination of evil , so that what is heav enly might prev ail within them.

**¶22:**

The third working : The interior states and the structural truths that divide them were relieved of the burden of evil , freed from carrying what opp ressed them, and the heav iness ceased . The abundance of good was able to d well freely in the inter iors.

**¶23:** The fourth working: That Providence might purify and cleanse the dwelling - places of the mind — every state in which spiritual life res ides.

**¶24:**

The fifth working: Because the great ness and the abundance of wisdom that dwells in the doc trinal forms — as one exam ines them, one finds that those who dwell within these doc trinal forms are pur ified and made holy.

**¶25:**

The sixth working: That one might find the mixed, incomplete, and un confined forms of worship in the interior mind brought to rest and purified; since the peace of heaven reaches them and passes through them and makes them clean .

**¶26:**

The seventh working: That the very nature of these receptacles of evil, advancing out ward to their proper places and stations , would no longer m ingle with what is interior .

**¶27:** The eighth working: That great boundaries and walls of spiritual order would be made, and conf ine everything that is evil within fixed limits.

**¶29:**

The tenth working: That at the end of all things , these recept acles would become the means of final release and purification of everything, like the fire of the Lord's judgment that cons umes what is false and evil utt erly.

**¶30:**

The eleventh working: That a final passage would be accomplished , and the entire domin ion of the ruling aff ections of self -love would be carried —

**¶31:** — to the ou termost region , for the heav enly aff ections bore no envy toward this arrangement , nor any resistance ; because the states of heav enly light are beyond all of this — the state of peace, the state of honor and grace, the state where the joy of those who dwell in the Lord 's house shall never pass away nor dimin ish.

**¶32:**

The twelfth working: That all the operations of spiritual loss might be found hidden from the states of heavenly light, because of the wall of consuming fire that surrounds the entire structure of creation ; and these imp ure things are manifest only within their own con finement.

**¶33 :** There was a need for these twelve great workings of Providence because the receptacles of evil that were expelled and swept out from the interior states down to the natural mind , and were also swept from the natural mind to the utter most boundary , are watched over by three living Words of divine truth that are set over them in great power — that they might guard over them until the final time. Because of this, these ev ils are held firmly in their bonds , in the manner that has been described .

reconstructions.reconstructed_text: Tell us, and instruct us about these three vessels that [were cast out] and were discharged from above, and how they were discharged and separated from all the rulers who are arranged in the heavens. For it is a necessity for us to know the manner in which the three vessels have been discharged, while the rulers were flourishing in their body.
Happen you know, that when these vessels were discharged, they were discharged in [a great] slaughter, but those [works from above drew forth] these vessels from them.

They are like the form of a man who has fallen into a purulent sickness. Other wounds and diseases are in his body, and even bile and other poisons are in his inner limbs. He achieves good health by a wise doctor, who gives him one remedy to drink that causes his purulent sickness to break out above, and gives him another medicine to drink that causes his sickness to discharge below, and he gives him yet another medicine to drink that cures his wounds for him [and they are healed] calmly and silently.

Through the skill of a wise doctor, with his effective medicines to consume that take away all sicknesses in this manner and dissolve all magic, the doctors shall [work their healing;] they work cures through the aroma of the medicine, other wounds [of] what is hidden, they at last tear them out from [the inner limbs, and they are] manifested above and below [through] the aroma of edible medicines that were placed upon them.

This is also what these vessels of water, of darkness and of fire are like, which are hidden in the body of all the rulers above; while the Living Spirit is like the wise doctor. These three healing drugs are the three garments that the Living Spirit assumes upon his body: of wind, of water, and of fire. Through them he has set in order the things below. For by those three garments he has been displayed to the rulers who are above, with hard-heartedness, with shaking and fear, with derangement; from them he discharged the three vessels, those of water, of darkness and of fire.

The case of these vessels is just like a child who is in his mother's womb and is swathed by seven garments. The first is the marrow, the second is the bones, the third is the tendons, the fourth is the flesh, the fifth the veins, the sixth the blood, the seventh the skin of the body that covers him. The other garment also [that wraps him is the covering of the womb, and the ninth is the womb itself in which he lies in the womb of his mother. His mother also is just like] this child. The marrow and the bones, the sinews and flesh, the veins and blood and skin, together with the garment that she wears and the linen that swathes her, total nine. Together with the nine of the child, these and the others, they shall complete and make eighteen garments. Now, you shall find the soul of this child is entwined within all these.

And look see: When the smell of the action of the demon, which brings about the stench of birth, will reveal the child; immediately [the child] shall [press through] all [these things] and it emerges from a crack that has become visible, while no tear nor wound occurs in the body of the child. In the same way as this child opens up the womb of his mother, so is it also with these vessels of water, of darkness and of fire. The actions that open up his mother to the child, and she shakes him out and reveals him; these are the three living garments that the Living Spirit assumed on his body.

For by the aspect of the garment of water [in which he was displayed, he drew forth and discharged the bitter waters] from the rulers; he moved [them out and cast them down, for] they are the poison and death with which their veins and entrails are filled.

By the aspect of the garment of wind, in which he was revealed [to the rulers,] he has swept away and erased the entire destructive shadow and dirt, discharged it down to the earth. Afterwards he swept it out and confined it in the vessel of darkness that surrounds the universe.

Also, by the garment of living fire, through its splendour and vigour, he discharged the fire of the darkness from all the rulers and threw it down upon this earth. He swept it another time from the earth and confined it in the vessel that surrounds all the worlds, and they call it the wall of great fire.

Now, those three garments, through which he established these three things, he did not peel them off all at once; but he stripped them off one by one at the appropriate time [and he brought them] down to the earth [in their order.]
In this way the universe of the [heavens was set in order, and] his vessels [were discharged; and] these vessels like [the three healing medicines were swept out and confined in their places.]

The use of the matter, and the management of these vessels that were swept out and discharged from above to earth, have brought an advantage and benefit of twelve great deeds. Afterwards, they were swept from the earth and pushed outside to the edges of the worlds and to the extremity.
The first deed is this: So that evil-doing does not increase in the universe, neither in the creations nor in the trees [nor in all flesh; for evil has set i]tself up in three things.
The [first is lust and desire of the flesh.]

The second is error [and the persuasion of false counsel.] For, if it were so, if [the vessel of water] had not been swept down from above, but rather the waters existing up till now in the rulers above [had remained among them, then the] torrents that would flow [down from above] and the droplets that would [drip] down, so lust would have sprouted [unceasingly i]n the trees and in the fruits as well as all flesh [that exists] down [upon the earth and would have multiplied in all things.]

Not only this, but if the vessel of darkness had not been swept out and thrown down to the earth, nor swept from the earth and cast outside the region of the worlds into this pit; again the drops of darkness, which will drip down from it, and the torrents that will continue to flow down from above to the earth and assume the trees and all flesh, would have multiplied,

Furthermore, if the fire were in the rulers of the worlds of the heavens until today, and had not been swept out and cast down to the earth, and swept from the earth and shut up inside the vessel of fire that surrounds the worlds; [then] this fire [would have continued to flow from] above through the torrent [of flames, and the torrent would have descended] below;
and the dark fire would have multiplied in the tree and in fruit and in all flesh.
The second deed: Al[l] the heavens [were purified and cleansed] of the sediment and the pollution [of the darkness,] so that [the light] surpasses in them [and prevails.]

[The third]: The heavens and the firmaments [were freed from the b]urden [of evil, and they were] relieved from the weight-carriers [that oppressed them,] and it ceased being heavy. This rich one [of light was set free to dwell] above.
The fourth: That they might purify and cleanse their dwelling places [in which the living soul dwells and the light resides.]
The fifth: Because the greatness and the richness that dwells in these ships, as it [is made manifest,] you might find them living in these ships, purified and holy.
The sixth: That you might find the mixed, incomplete, and unconfined temples above at rest and purified; since rest will reach them and pass through them and purify them.
The seventh: [That the] nature alone of the vessels, which will advance and extend to their places and sites [of confinement, should no longer be mingled] in [the heights with what is above.]
The eighth: That great enclosures and walls would be made, and confine everything.
The tenth deed: That they would become releasers and purifiers of everything at the end of the universe like the fire [of the great judgment that] burns [and consumes all evil utterly.]
The eleventh deed: [That they] will make a crossing [for the light,] and the entire ruling-power [of the darkness would be carried]

to the outer land, for they were not envious of this [arrangement, for they are like] a man who is richer than them; because the aeons of light are outside [all of this, in] the place [that is the dwelling] of peace, the place of honour and grace, the place where the joy of the householders who dwell in it shall never pass away nor recede.

The twelfth: That you might find all the deeds of loss hidden from the aeons of light, because of the wall of fire that surrounds the entire building; and these unclean things are displayed (only) in its [place of confinement alone.]

There was a need for these twelve great deeds because the vessels that were discharged and swept out from the firmaments to the earth, and were also swept from the earth to the extr[emity of the worlds. And] the three words of life watch over them that [they might not be loosed; for the words of life ar]e set over them in great power [and authority,] that they might watch over them at the last time; because of this, they are firmly set thus in these fetters,
